# IMG_0020.jpeg

The Star Colonel's own photo IMG_0020, published in this repository at his order of 2026-10-28. The photo shows only him. It is a photograph with one blurred box; the other two files in this folder are generated from it.

- Source file: `data/external/henryk-urodziny-2026/images/IMG_0020.jpeg`, unchanged
- Source sha256: `006468b0fdcac615d31b214d2248c7d1e15f8d8a075a6f9256d3949a4f43e17d`
- This file sha256: `1949d902ca7a9726d436b1ae402788f9ec9c84aca2ff0cce3e5e733a9fc7cbf4`
- Pixels: equal to the source file's first image except the blurred box below, up to JPEG requantisation: the file was re-encoded with the source's two quantisation tables and 4:2:0 subsampling, which changes 3.7 percent of the RGB values outside the box by at most 12 levels (mean 0.050 levels)
- Blurred box 1: `[324, 2040, 581, 2141]` - rear licence plate (Polish EU format) of the dark estate car parked on the left; the plate is `[375, 2065, 530, 2116]`, the blur is at full strength over `[336, 2052, 569, 2129]` and fades linearly over 12 px to the box edge; pixelated to 32 px blocks, then a Gaussian blur of radius 8; no character is readable at 4x
- Box coordinates: the shown orientation, 4896 x 3672 px, `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`, end exclusive
- Metadata removed: the Exif APP1 (GPS position, device make and model, software, host computer, date and time), the XMP APP1, the MPF APP2 index, the ISO 21496-1 gain-map APP2, the Apple AROT APP10 and the second image after the first image's end marker (the HDR gain map)
- Metadata kept: the JFIF APP0 header (300 dpi), the ICC_PROFILE APP2 colour profile and a new Exif APP1 holding only the Orientation tag (value 6), so the photo shows at 4896 x 3672 px (stored 3672 x 4896 px)
- Encoding: standard Huffman tables and no restart interval, where the source has its own
- Read back: no GPS position, device make or model, software, date or time, XMP or MPF remains
- Superseded copy: the earlier showcase file with the plate readable, sha256 `729a7b7d724fe599dc41d745d9cb8d9d170db3fd95fecaa3ef97637478b084ae`, was moved to the trash on 2026-10-28
